sentences.en: School systems have to cope with changing numbers of pupils.
sentences.zh: 学校系统必须应对学生人数的变化。

sentences.en: The changing seasons in Japan do much to Japan's agriculture.
sentences.zh: 日本四季变换对日本农业影响很大。

sentences.en: Each person has different views with regard to changing jobs.
sentences.zh: 每个人对于换工作有不同的看法。

phrases.zh: 阿尔及利亚正在发生变化

senses.zh: 改变，变化；更换，替换；换乘（change 的现在分词）
